content:
{
  "phoneNote": "The typographic editorial style suits an accounting firm well, but the address and directions block is repeated verbatim right below the contact section, and the sticky top header covers the director's name when scrolling.",
  "desktopNote": "The asymmetric Swiss typographic layout gives the firm a credible, distinctive presence, though repeating the address block right after the contact section creates unnecessary redundancy at the bottom.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 4,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 4,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Remove the redundant 'Obiščite nas' address and directions section at the bottom, as the exact same information is already shown immediately above it in 'Kje nas najdete'.",
    "Move the mobile call/directions bar to the bottom of the viewport or compact the sticky header so it does not take up two rows at the top of the screen.",
    "Align the 'Delamo od leta 2004' callout with the top of the 'Naša zgodba' heading on desktop so the left column does not feel empty above the number."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "On both phone and desktop, the 'Obiščite nas' block at the bottom repeats the exact same address and directions link already shown immediately above in 'Kje nas najdete'."
  ]
}
